recognize_zh: 結腸隱窩結構大致保留，但固有層被中型至大型、染色質較開放的異型淋巴細胞密集擴張，隱窩並未被破壞；CD56 免疫染色瀰漫強陽性，提示 NK 細胞來源的增生。
features: Colonic mucosa with preserved crypt architecture and intact surface epithelium (panel A)
Dense, band-like infiltrate expanding the lamina propria between crypts
Medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei, open chromatin and moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm (panel B)
No conspicuous epitheliotropism or crypt destruction at this magnification
Diffuse strong membranous CD56 positivity of the infiltrate (panel C)
Paranuclear cytoplasmic granules are not clearly resolved at this image resolution
describe_en: Sections of a colonic polyp show mucosa with preserved crypts overlying a dense lymphoid infiltrate that expands the lamina propria. The infiltrate is composed of medium to large atypical cells with irregular nuclei, open chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm; epitheliotropism, crypt destruction and angiodestructive necrosis are not evident in these fields. CD56 immunostain is diffusely and strongly positive. Together with CD3+ (cytoplasmic), CD5-, TCR-negative, cytotoxic granule-positive, EBER-negative phenotype, no clonal TCR rearrangement and an indolent course, findings are consistent with indolent NK-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: ENKTL shows angiocentric/angiodestructive growth with necrosis and is EBER-positive by ISH, whereas this lesion is EBER-negative without necrosis.
MEITL shows monomorphic cells with marked epitheliotropism, CD8+ and TCRγδ (or αβ) expression with clonal TCR rearrangement, all absent here.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: The indolent T-cell disorder consists of small, bland, CD4+ or CD8+ T cells with surface CD3 and clonal TCR rearrangement, unlike these larger CD56+ NK cells.

ddx.dx: Poorly differentiated carcinoma or neuroendocrine tumor
ddx.vs: Carcinoma and neuroendocrine neoplasms are cytokeratin-positive and form cohesive nests, whereas these discohesive cells are CD2/CD3/CD56-positive lymphoid cells.
